info.title: DZ Bus Tracker API
info.description:
Real-time bus tracking for Algeria.

* JSON uses snake_case; timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC.
* Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code`, localized in French (default), Arabic or English via `Accept-Language`.
* Lists use cursor pagination: `?limit=` (1–100) and `?cursor=` from `next_cursor`.
* Cacheable GETs return a weak `ETag`; send `If-None-Match` to get `304`.
* Rate limits are reported in `RateLimit-*` headers; `429` carries `Retry-After`.

get.summary: Public keys that verify access tokens (JSON Web Key Set, RFC 7517).
List machine-to-machine API keys.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page.

200.description: A page of keys (secrets are never returned)

post.summary: Create a scoped API key. The secret is returned once (audited).

201.description: Key created; store the secret now

get.summary: Read the append-only audit log (newest first).
List user accounts (newest first).
One user account.

patch.summary: Activate/deactivate an account or change its role (audited; signs the user out).

403.description: Not an administrator, or targeting yourself

post.summary: Sign in with e-mail and password.

401.description: Invalid credentials (unknown account, wrong password, locked or disabled account)

post.summary: End the current session (its access and refresh tokens stop working immediately).
End every session of the caller (all devices).
Change the password. Other sessions are signed out; the current one stays valid.

422.description: Wrong current password or weak new password

post.summary: Request a password-reset e-mail. Always accepted, whether or not the account exists.

202.description: If the account exists, an e-mail is on its way

post.summary: Set a new password with the token from the reset e-mail. Every session is signed out.

Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair. The presented refresh token is spent;
presenting it again revokes the whole session.

401.description: Invalid, expired or reused refresh token

post.summary: Create a passenger account and sign it in.

get.summary: List the caller's active sessions (devices).

200.description: Active sessions, most recently used first

delete.summary: Sign out one of the caller's sessions (e.g. a lost phone).

get.summary: List lines (newest first). Active lines only, unless the caller administers lines.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the code or name (2–100 characters, case-insensitive).

parameters.name: is_active
parameters.description: Activity filter, for line administrators only (`403` otherwise).

get.summary: One line, with its number of stops and whether it has a route.

delete.summary:
Delete a line with its stop list and schedules (audited); refused while buses are assigned
to it.

409.description: Buses are assigned to the line (`line_in_use`)

patch.summary:
Update a line partially (audited). The code cannot change; `is_active` activates or
deactivates the line.

get.summary: The route of a line as a GeoJSON `LineString`.

404.description: No such (visible) line, or no route set

put.summary:
Set the route of a line (audited). Replaces the legacy route segments, which any user could
write (L-04).

422.description: Not a valid `LineString`: 2–10 000 positions in range, no repeated consecutive position

delete.summary: Remove the route of a line (idempotent, audited).

204.description: The line has no route any more

get.summary:
The schedules of a line by day and start time (not paginated). Active schedules only,
unless the caller administers schedules.

post.summary: Add a schedule to a line (audited). This is the only way to create a schedule.

409.description: Overlaps an active schedule of the line on that day (`schedule_overlap`)

get.summary:
The stops of a line by position (not paginated: at most 200). Inactive stops are listed
with `is_active: false`.

put.summary:
Replace the whole ordered stop list atomically (audited). Distances from the previous stop
are recomputed.

422.description: More than 200 stops, a repeated (`duplicate`) or unknown (`unknown_reference`) stop, or a segment time on the first stop (`not_allowed`)

post.summary: Insert one stop into a line (audited); later stops shift by one.

409.description: The stop is already on the line (`stop_already_on_line`)

422.description: Unknown stop, position past the end, line full, or a segment time at position 0

delete.summary:
Remove a stop from a line (audited); later stops shift back and the distance of the next
stop is recomputed.

404.description: No such line, or the stop is not on it

get.summary: The caller's account and profile.

put.summary:
Set the avatar to a completed upload (purpose `avatar`). The previous avatar file is deleted
in the background.

403.description: API keys cannot manage an avatar

409.description: The upload was attached by a concurrent request (`upload_already_used`), or the avatar changed concurrently (`stale_state`)

422.description: `upload_id` is not a usable avatar upload of the caller: unknown, expired, already used or not matching its declaration (`invalid_upload`)

delete.summary: Remove the avatar (idempotent). The file is deleted in the background.

403.description: API keys cannot manage an avatar

get.summary: The caller's profile preferences.

patch.summary:
Update profile preferences. A language change applies to new access tokens (after the
next refresh).

get.summary:
One schedule. Inactive schedules, and schedules of inactive lines, are only visible to
schedule administrators.

patch.summary:
Update a schedule partially (audited), with the same validation and overlap rules as
creation.

get.summary: List stops (newest first). Active stops only, unless the caller administers stops.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the name (2–100 characters, case-insensitive).

parameters.name: line_id
parameters.description: Only stops served by this line.

parameters.name: is_active
parameters.description: Activity filter, for stop administrators only (`403` otherwise).

get.summary: Active stops around a point, nearest first (not paginated).

200.description: Stops within the radius, with their distance

422.description: Missing or out-of-range coordinates, radius or limit

get.summary: One stop. Inactive stops are only visible to stop administrators.

delete.summary: Delete a stop that no line serves (audited). Its photo is deleted in the background.

409.description: A line still serves the stop (`stop_in_use`), or its photo changed concurrently (`stale_state`)

patch.summary: Update a stop partially (audited). Moving a stop recomputes the distances of its lines.

409.description: Lines kept gaining the moved stop concurrently (`stale_state`)

get.summary: Lines serving a stop, ordered by code (inactive lines for line administrators only).

put.summary:
Set the photo of a stop to a completed upload (purpose `stop_photo`, audited). The previous
photo is deleted in the background. Uploads belong to a signed-in user: API keys cannot
attach photos.

409.description: The upload was attached concurrently (`upload_already_used`), or the photo changed concurrently (`stale_state`)

422.description: `upload_id` is not a usable `stop_photo` upload of the caller (`invalid_upload`)

delete.summary: Remove the photo of a stop (idempotent, audited). The file is deleted in the background.

204.description: The stop has no photo any more

post.summary:
Request an upload URL. The file is then sent directly to storage with the returned request
(type and exact size are signed) and attached to a resource by id before `expires_at`.
Uploads belong to a signed-in user: API keys cannot request them.

201.description: Pending upload with its presigned request (not cacheable)

403.description: Purpose not allowed for the caller, or an API key

422.description: Type not accepted or size out of range for the purpose

get.summary: One of the caller's uploads: whether it is still pending or already attached.

404.description: No such upload of the caller

get.summary:
Liveness: the process is up. Never touches dependencies (a database outage must not get
healthy API containers restarted).
Readiness: database reachable, migrations applied, Valkey reachable.

AddLineStopRequest.description: Inserts one stop into a line.

position.description: 0-based position; later stops shift by one. Default: after the last stop.

time_from_previous_s.description: Travel time from the previous stop (0–86400 s); not allowed at position 0.

AdminUpdateUserRequest.description: Administrative account changes. Deactivation or a role change signs the user out.

prefix.description: Public identifier (first part of the key).

expires_at.description: Optional expiry (at most two years ahead).

scopes.description: Permission codes granted to the key (e.g. `tracking:read`, `notification:send`).

CreateUploadRequest.description: Declares a file to upload. Its type and exact size are signed into the upload URL.

content_type.description: Media type of the file, e.g. `image/jpeg` (accepted types depend on the purpose).

size_bytes.description: Exact size of the file in bytes.

CreatedApiKeyDto.description: A new key. `secret` is shown only in this response: store it securely.

GeoJsonLineStringType.description: GeoJSON geometry type of a line route.

ItemList_LineDto.description: A bounded list that is not paginated (e.g. the stops of a line).

frequency_minutes.description: Announced headway in minutes, when the line runs at a fixed frequency.

is_active.description: Inactive lines are only visible to line administrators.

ItemList_LineStopDto.description: A bounded list that is not paginated (e.g. the stops of a line).

items.description: A stop at its position on a line.

distance_from_previous_m.description: Geodesic distance from the previous stop in metres; `null` for the first stop.

time_from_previous_s.description: Scheduled travel time from the previous stop in seconds, when known.

ItemList_NearbyStopDto.description: A bounded list that is not paginated (e.g. the stops of a line).

distance_m.description: Distance from the searched point, in metres.

items.description: A stop found around a point.

ItemList_ScheduleDto.description: A bounded list that is not paginated (e.g. the stops of a line).

items.description: A weekly service window of a line.

is_active.description: Only active schedules are public; they may not overlap on the same day.

Language.description: Preferred language for messages and notifications.

LatLng.description: A position in degrees (WGS 84): `lat` in [-90, 90], `lng` in [-180, 180].

frequency_minutes.description: Announced headway in minutes, when the line runs at a fixed frequency.

is_active.description: Inactive lines are only visible to line administrators.

LineStopDto.description: A stop at its position on a line.

distance_from_previous_m.description: Geodesic distance from the previous stop in metres; `null` for the first stop.

time_from_previous_s.description: Scheduled travel time from the previous stop in seconds, when known.

LineStopEntryRequest.description: One stop of a line's ordered list.

time_from_previous_s.description: Travel time from the previous stop (0–86400 s); not allowed on the first stop.

MeDto.description: The caller's account with its profile.

distance_m.description: Distance from the searched point, in metres.

NearbyStopDto.description: A stop found around a point.

Paginated_ApiKeyDto.description: A page of results. Pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` to fetch the next page.

prefix.description: Public identifier (first part of the key).

Paginated_AuditEntryDto.description: A page of results. Pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` to fetch the next page.

Paginated_LineDto.description: A page of results. Pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` to fetch the next page.

frequency_minutes.description: Announced headway in minutes, when the line runs at a fixed frequency.

is_active.description: Inactive lines are only visible to line administrators.

Paginated_StopDto.description: A page of results. Pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` to fetch the next page.

is_active.description: Inactive stops are only visible to stop administrators.

photo_url.description:
Presigned download URL of the photo (stable for an hour); `null` without photo or when
file storage is not available.

Paginated_UserDto.description: A page of results. Pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` to fetch the next page.

token.description: The token from the e-mailed link (URL fragment `#token=…`).

PresignedRequestDto.description: The request the client performs itself to upload the file directly to storage.

headers.description: Headers to send with exactly these values (`content-type`, `content-length`).

ProblemDocument.description: RFC 9457 problem document returned by every error response.

instance.description: The request path that produced the problem.

ProblemFieldError.description: A field error in a problem document.

avatar_url.description:
Presigned download URL of the avatar (stable for an hour); `null` without avatar or when
file storage is not available.

password.description: At least 12 characters; common and personal passwords are refused.

ReplaceLineStopsRequest.description: The whole ordered stop list of a line (0–200 distinct, existing stops).

RouteDto.description:
A GeoJSON `LineString`: 2–10 000 positions `[lng, lat]` (no altitude), no two
consecutive positions equal.

ScheduleDto.description: A weekly service window of a line.

is_active.description: Only active schedules are public; they may not overlap on the same day.

SessionDto.description: An active session of the caller.

current.description: True for the session making this request.

SetAvatarRequest.description: Sets the avatar to a completed `avatar` upload.

upload_id.description: Id returned by `POST /uploads` (purpose `avatar`), after the file was uploaded.

SetPhotoRequest.description: Attaches a completed upload as a photo.

upload_id.description: Id returned by `POST /uploads` (purpose `stop_photo`), after the file was uploaded.

is_active.description: Inactive stops are only visible to stop administrators.

photo_url.description:
Presigned download URL of the photo (stable for an hour); `null` without photo or when
file storage is not available.

StopSummaryDto.description: The essentials of a stop, as listed on a line.

is_active.description: Inactive stops stay on their lines (buses pass them) but cannot be boarded.

TokenPairDto.description:
Bearer token pair. Clients must serialise refresh calls: presenting a spent refresh token
revokes the whole session.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

UpdateLineRequest.description:
Changes to a line (`code` is immutable). `null` clears `frequency_minutes` and `fare_dza`;
`is_active` replaces the legacy activate/deactivate actions.

UpdateMeRequest.description: Self-service account changes. Send `phone_number: null` to remove the number.

UpdateScheduleRequest.description: Changes to a schedule (same rules as creation).

UpdateStopRequest.description: Changes to a stop; absent fields are unchanged and an empty text clears a text field.

UploadDto.description:
A pending upload. Upload the file with `upload` before `expires_at`, then pass `id` to the
endpoint that attaches it (e.g. `PUT /me/avatar`).

UploadPurposeDto.description: What an upload will be attached to.

UploadStatusViewDto.description: An upload of the caller, without its (single-use) presigned request.
